translations.arberry: But when they saw it, they said, 'Surely we are gone astray;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
translations.khattab: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
translations.arberry: violent that He compelled against them seven nights and eight days, uninterruptedly, and thou mightest see the people laid prostrate in it as if they were the stumps of fallen down palm-trees.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَهَلۡ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Then do you see of them any remains?
translations.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
translations.khattab: Do you see any of them left alive
translations.arberry: Now dost thou see any remnant of them?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهُۥ بَعِيدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
translations.pickthall: Lo! they behold it afar off
translations.khattab: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible
translations.arberry: behold, they see it as if far off;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: But We see it [as] near.
translations.pickthall: While we behold it nigh:
translations.khattab: but We see it as inevitable
translations.arberry: but We see it is nigh.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
translations.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
translations.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
translations.arberry: Have you not regarded how God created seven heavens one upon another,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
translations.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
translations.khattab: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower
translations.arberry: Until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسࣰ ا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
translations.pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
translations.khattab: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold
translations.arberry: therein they shall recline upon couches, therein they shall see neither sun nor bitter cold;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣰ ا مَّنثُورࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
translations.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
translations.khattab: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls
translations.arberry: Immortal youths shall go about them; when thou seest them, thou supposest them scattered pearls,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا

translations.saheeh: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
translations.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
translations.khattab: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
translations.arberry: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا

translations.saheeh: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
translations.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
translations.khattab: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom
translations.arberry: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And he showed him the greatest sign,
translations.pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
translations.khattab: Then Moses showed him the great sign
translations.arberry: So he showed him the great sign,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
translations.pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
translations.khattab: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
translations.arberry: and Hell is advanced for whoever sees,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا

translations.saheeh: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
translations.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
translations.khattab: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning
translations.arberry: It shall be as if; on the day they see it, they have but tarried for an evening, or its forenoon.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ

translations.saheeh: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
translations.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
translations.khattab: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon
translations.arberry: he truly saw him on the clear horizon;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

translations.saheeh: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
translations.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
translations.khattab: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
translations.arberry: and when they saw them they said, 'Lo, these men are astray!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

translations.saheeh: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
translations.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
translations.khattab: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
translations.arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with Ad,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

translations.saheeh: Does he think that no one has seen him?
translations.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
translations.khattab: Do they think that no one sees them
translations.arberry: What, does he think none has seen him?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
translations.pickthall: That he thinketh himself independent!
translations.khattab: once they think they are self-sufficient
translations.arberry: for he thinks himself self-sufficient.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Have you seen the one who forbids
translations.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
translations.khattab: Have you seen the man who prevents
translations.arberry: What thinkest thou? He who forbids

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
translations.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
translations.khattab: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided
translations.arberry: What thinkest thou? If he were upon guidance

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
translations.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
translations.khattab: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away
translations.arberry: What thinkest thou? If he cries lies, and turns away -

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Does he not know that Allah sees?
translations.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
translations.khattab: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺
translations.arberry: Did he not know that God sees?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

translations.saheeh: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
translations.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
translations.khattab: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds
translations.arberry: Upon that day men shall issue in scatterings to see their works,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
translations.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
translations.khattab: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
translations.arberry: and whoso has done an atom's weight of good shall see it,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ

translations.saheeh: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
translations.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
translations.khattab: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
translations.arberry: and whoso has done an atom's weight of evil shall see it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ

translations.saheeh: You will surely see the Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: For ye will behold hell-fire.
translations.khattab: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire
translations.arberry: you shall surely see Hell;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ

translations.saheeh: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
translations.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
translations.khattab: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty
translations.arberry: Again, you shall surely see it with the eye of certainty

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ

translations.saheeh: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
translations.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
translations.khattab: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
translations.arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with the Men of the Elephant?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
translations.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
translations.khattab: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment
translations.arberry: Hast thou seen him who cries lies to the Doom?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ

translations.saheeh: Those who make show [of their deeds]
translations.pickthall: Who would be seen (at worship)
translations.khattab: those who ˹only˺ show off
translations.arberry: to those who make display

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
translations.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
translations.khattab: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds
translations.arberry: and thou seest men entering God's religion in throngs,
